claims.statement: For every odd prime power q, the maximum string C-group rank of PSL(4,q) is four.
claims.retained_published_input: L048 Theorem 1.1: rank-four existence for every odd prime power q.
claims.not_claimed: The 2016 construction proof or all principal results of L048 are not rederived by this package.

claims.statement: A finite irreducible subgroup of PGL4(k), k algebraically closed of odd characteristic, which is a string C-group of rank at least five with every adjacent pair noncommuting, preserves a nondegenerate symmetric or alternating bilinear form up to scalar.
claims.scope: Projective linear actions; similarity multipliers allowed. Not a classification of form-preserving groups or of field/graph automorphism extensions.
